summary: Bullish entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Equiniti from Siris Capital in a $4.2 billion all-stock transaction, with consideration paid in newly-issued ordinary shares valued at $4.2 billion based on a 30-day VWAP of $38.4797 per share; the merger is expected to close in Q1 2027 and will result in significant share issuance upon closing. No changes to BTC holdings, debt, or preferred equity were disclosed.
